class.name: vfs_io
class.brief: A root association and descriptor table for one VFS I/O context.
class.details:
The caller provides the slot array and its capacity. Initialization, root association, clear and disposal require exclusive lifecycle access; all other methods support concurrent callers. The object and its array must outlive all table calls, and the array must only be accessed through this API after initialization. No heap allocation or mutex is required. Short system critical sections protect slots and reference acquisition, independently of VFS_CFG_USE_MUTUAL_EXCLUSION. Driver methods and final node disposal always run outside these sections.
Admitted nodes must use __ro_addref_impl and __ro_release_impl, and keep their VMT unchanged while referenced. Custom disposal is supported. This class requires synchronized OOP references and is unavailable with OOP_USE_NOTHING. Returned node references protect lifetime only; the caller must still serialize operations on a shared node when needed. Each occupied slot owns one node reference. The root pointer is borrowed, initially NULL, and must remain stable during use. The application keeps roots and backing file systems alive through all operations and node disposal, including references obtained from get. Clear and disposal never dispose the root. Sharing a root shares its CWD and mounts; separate roots provide independent path state. Path methods return ENOSYS when no root is associated, and are omitted when root support is disabled. Descriptor methods remain available.
Open reserves a slot before any driver call. Pending opens occupy slots but cannot be looked up, closed or duplicated. Install and dup2 return EBUSY for a reserved destination. No table protection spans a driver call, buffer wait or reference release. Slot allocation scans the caller-sized array under a system critical section, so capacities should remain small. Methods run in thread context unless marked X.

field.name: root
field.brief: Borrowed root, stable during use; internal access only.

field.name: nodes
field.brief: Caller-owned slot array, private after initialization.

field.name: size
field.brief: Number of slots, immutable after initialization.

objinit.param: Slot array, or NULL for a zero-capacity table. Existing contents are discarded, so the array must not own references before initialization.

method.name: vfsIOInsert
method.brief: Transfers a node reference into the lowest free slot.
method.details: Consumes one caller-owned reference on success only. NULL is rejected with EINVAL and custom reference methods with ENOTSUP. A full table returns EMFILE.
method.return: A nonnegative descriptor or an encoded error.

method.name: vfsIOInstall
method.brief: Transfers a node reference into a specified empty slot.
method.details: Consumes one caller-owned reference on success only. Invalid descriptors return EBADF, occupied or reserved slots EBUSY, NULL nodes EINVAL and custom reference methods ENOTSUP.
method.return: CH_RET_SUCCESS or an encoded error.

method.name: vfsIOGet
method.brief: Acquires a node reference from a descriptor.
method.details: The caller must release the returned reference using roRelease(). It remains valid after the descriptor is closed or replaced. No node operation is performed under table protection.
method.return: An owned reference, or NULL for an invalid, empty or reserved slot or reference counter overflow.

method.name: vfsIOClose
method.brief: Detaches a descriptor and releases its reference.
method.details: The slot is reusable before release or final disposal runs. These callbacks may block or reenter the table.
method.return: CH_RET_SUCCESS, or EBADF for an invalid, empty or reserved slot.

method.name: vfsIODup
method.brief: Duplicates a descriptor into the lowest free slot.
method.return: A nonnegative descriptor, or encoded EBADF, EMFILE or EOVERFLOW. Errors leave slots and references unchanged.

method.name: vfsIODup2
method.brief: Duplicates a descriptor, atomically replacing a destination.
method.details: The displaced reference is released after publishing the replacement and leaving table protection. Equal descriptors are validated and returned unchanged. A reserved destination returns EBUSY.
method.return: The destination descriptor, or encoded EBADF, EBUSY or EOVERFLOW. Errors leave slots and references unchanged.

method.name: vfsIOClear
method.brief: Releases all descriptors during exclusive lifecycle access.
method.details: Also called by object disposal. No other table operation may run concurrently, and disposal callbacks must not repopulate the table. Each slot is detached before its reference is released outside protection. Previously acquired node references remain valid. The empty table can be reused after this method returns.

method.name: vfsIORead
method.details: The selected node is retained throughout the call, including driver waits. The caller serializes operations on the same open node.
method.param: Data buffer, or NULL when n is zero.
method.return: The byte count or an encoded error.

method.name: vfsIOWrite
method.details: The selected node is retained throughout the call, including driver waits. The caller serializes operations on the same open node.
method.param: Data buffer, or NULL when n is zero.
method.return: The byte count or an encoded error.

method.name: vfsIOFstat
method.return: The operation result or an encoded error.

method.name: vfsIOSeek
method.brief: Changes and returns the file position.
method.details: The caller serializes position-dependent operations on the same node. Directories return EISDIR and non-regular files ESPIPE.
method.return: The resulting file position or an encoded error.

method.name: vfsIOTell
method.details: The caller serializes position-dependent operations on the same node. Directories return EISDIR and non-regular files ESPIPE.
method.return: The resulting file position or an encoded error.

method.name: vfsIOReadDirectoryFirst
method.details: The caller serializes enumeration on the same open directory.
method.return: One for an entry, zero at end, or an encoded error.

method.name: vfsIOReadDirectoryNext
method.details: The caller serializes enumeration on the same open directory.
method.return: One for an entry, zero at end, or an encoded error.

method.name: vfsIOControl
method.details: Argument validation and lifetime follow the selected control operation. Libc and sandbox marshalling remain the adapter responsibility.
method.return: The operation result or an encoded error.

method.name: vfsIOSetRoot
method.brief: Associates a borrowed root with an I/O context.
method.details: Requires exclusive lifecycle access with no concurrent calls, including get-root. Existing descriptors are unchanged. Their owners must remain alive. The root is neither retained nor disposed by this object.
method.param: Root, or NULL to disable path operations.
method.implementation: self->root = root;

method.name: vfsIOOpen
method.brief: Opens a file or directory and returns a descriptor.
method.details: A slot is reserved before entering the root. A full table returns EMFILE without invoking a driver. Failed opens cancel the reservation; rejected node references are released outside table protection. Standard OOP reference methods are required. Read-only opens also accept directories.
method.param: Absolute or relative path within the associated root.
method.return: A nonnegative descriptor or an encoded error.

method.name: vfsIOStat
method.details: Uses the associated root and its existing local synchronization. Returns ENOSYS if no root is associated.
method.param: Absolute or relative path within the associated root.
method.return: The operation result or an encoded error.

method.name: vfsIOUnlink
method.details: Uses the associated root and its existing local synchronization. Returns ENOSYS if no root is associated.
method.param: Absolute or relative path within the associated root.
method.return: The operation result or an encoded error.

method.name: vfsIORename
method.details: Uses the associated root and its existing local synchronization. Returns ENOSYS if no root is associated.
method.return: The operation result or an encoded error.

method.name: vfsIOMkdir
method.details: Uses the associated root and its existing local synchronization. Returns ENOSYS if no root is associated.
method.param: Absolute or relative path within the associated root.
method.return: The operation result or an encoded error.

method.name: vfsIORmdir
method.details: Uses the associated root and its existing local synchronization. Returns ENOSYS if no root is associated.
method.param: Absolute or relative path within the associated root.
method.return: The operation result or an encoded error.

method.name: vfsIOChdir
method.brief: Changes the associated root current directory.
method.details: Uses the associated root and its existing local synchronization. Returns ENOSYS if no root is associated.
method.param: Absolute or relative path within the associated root.
method.return: The operation result or an encoded error.

method.name: vfsIOGetcwd
method.brief: Copies the associated root current directory.
method.details: Uses the associated root and its existing local synchronization. Returns ENOSYS if no root is associated.
method.return: The operation result or an encoded error.

method.name: vfsIOGetRootX
method.details: The root association must remain stable during use. This getter does not retain the root.
method.return: The associated root or NULL.
method.implementation: return self->root;

variable.name: reserved_node
variable.brief: Private identity for a pending open; never dispatched.

function.name: is_node
function.brief: Distinguishes an occupied slot from empty or reserved slots.

function.name: check_node
function.brief: Checks whether a caller-owned node can be admitted.

function.name: retain_nodeI
function.brief: Pins an admitted node without dispatching a virtual method.
function.return: True on success, false on reference counter overflow.

function.name: pin_descriptor
function.brief: Acquires a reference while protecting descriptor lookup.
